# Curves from Mestre's ten-point construction: record curves

Snapshot of 2026-10-31; the list is still being extended. For each rank, the ten curves of this collection with the
smallest conductor, with generators of the Mordell-Weil group. Every curve has proven rank, trivial torsion, and is
given by its global minimal model. Conductors are exact integers; heights are natural logarithms; the naive height is
`log max(abs(c4)^3, c6^2)`.
